 Provide a photo of you and any dependent children included in your application. For more information, see Photo requirements for citizenship applications.
 Good character documents
 We need documents to assess if you are of good character.
 Overseas penal clearance certificates
-Give us an overseas penal clearance certificate if: you lived or travelled outside Australia since turning 18 years of age and you held a permanent visa at that time and the total time you spent outside Australia adds up to 12 months or more and the time you spent in any one country was 90 days or more or requested by the Department. Penal clearance certificates from New Zealand If the above applies to you and New Zealand is one of the countries where you spent time, you do not need to give us an overseas penal clearance certificate for New Zealand. We will request this directly from the New Zealand Ministry of Justice (NZ MOJ) for you. If you have not given us consent to do this in your application form, we will get your consent before we make the request. Do not contact the NZ MOJ as we do not accept overseas penal clearances from New Zealand provided by applicants. New Zealand citizen - Special Category Visa (SCV) holders If you are a New Zealand citizen who holds an SCV and have spent any time outside Australia since turning 18 years of age, we need you to get an overseas penal clearance certificate from any other country you have visited or stayed in for 90 days or more. This applies to you regardless of how long you have resided in Australia. For New Zealand citizens by grant this includes the country of usual residence before migration to New Zealand. You do not need to give us an overseas penal clearance certificate for New Zealand as we will request an overseas penal clearance certificate directly from the New Zealand Ministry of Justice for you. Do not contact the NZ MOJ as we do not accept overseas penal clearances from New Zealand provided by applicants. How to get an overseas penal clearance certificate You can get a penal clearance certificate from a country's government or law enforcement authority. Information about how to get a penal clearance for specific countries is available from Offices outside Australia > Police checks. For more information, including what to do if you can’t give us an overseas penal clearance certificate, see Character requirements for Australian Citizenship.
+Overseas penal clearance certificates, also called police checks in some countries, show if a person has a criminal record outside Australia. We ask for these certificates to help assess if you are of good character. You may need to give us an overseas penal clearance certificate if you have lived or travelled outside Australia since turning 18 years of age.
+Permanent Residence Visa holders
+Give us an overseas penal clearance certificate if all the following apply: you lived or travelled outside Australia since turning 18 years of age and this was in the last 10 years, or since you got your first permanent resident visa (use whichever is more recent) and you spent a total of 12 months or more outside Australia and you spent 90 days or more in any one country. We may also request a certificate directly from you if required. If New Zealand is one of the countries where you spent time and the above requirements apply: Do not get a New Zealand police certificate yourself. We will request the certificate directly from the New Zealand Ministry of Justice (NZ MOJ). If you have not given us consent in your application, we will contact you to get your consent before making the request.
+New Zealand citizen - Special Category Visa (SCV) holders
+Give us an overseas penal clearance certificate if, in the last 10 years: you lived or travelled outside Australia since turning 18 years of age and you spent a total of 12 months or more outside Australia and you spent 90 days or more in any one country. We may also request a certificate directly from you if required. If New Zealand is one of the countries where you spent time and the above requirements apply: Do not get a New Zealand police certificate yourself. We will request the certificate directly from the New Zealand Ministry of Justice (NZ MOJ). If you have not given us consent in your application, we will contact you to get your consent before making the request.
+How to get an overseas penal clearance certificate
+You can get an overseas penal clearance certificate from the relevant government or law enforcement authority in the country where you lived. Guidance on how to apply for an overseas penal clearance certificate or police check in specific countries is available at Offices outside Australia > Police checks. For more information, including what to do if you can’t give us an overseas penal clearance certificate, see Character requirements for Australian Citizenship.
 Australian National Police Check
 If you are 16 years of age or over, we will request a check on your behalf from the National Police Checking Service.

 Apply for citizenship
 Apply and pay online in ImmiAccount. Completing your application online, if possible, and giving us all the documents listed for your application type, helps us to finalise your application more quickly. You can apply from in or outside of Australia. Apply now
 See how to submit your citizenship application online in ImmiAccount. You must pay the fee when you lodge your application. See How to pay. Apply now
-In some situations, you might need to apply on paper. Use a paper application form if you: do not have a current or expired passport, or other travel document including a DFTTA, IMMICard, PLO56 (M56) or Titre de Voyage, or have not travelled in or out of Australia since July 1990, or are eligible for a fee exemption, or are claiming an Australian Defence Force residence exemption. Complete Form 1300t Australian citizenship General eligibility if you are aged between 18 and 59. Pre-pay your application fee online through ImmiAccount. Send your completed application with certified copies of your documents and the payment receipt to the address on the form. If you are applying for a fee exemption, send your completed application with certified copies of your documents to the address on the form.
+In some situations, you might need to apply on paper. Use a paper application form if you: do not have a current or expired passport, or other travel document including a DFTTA, IMMICard, PLO56 (M56) or Titre de Voyage, or have not travelled into or out of Australia since July 1990, or are eligible for a fee exemption, or are claiming the Australian Defence Service residence exemption, or were born outside Australia and are stateless. Complete Form 1300t Australian citizenship General eligibility if you are aged between 18 and 59. Pre-pay your application fee online through ImmiAccount. Send your completed application with certified copies of your documents and the payment receipt to the address on the form. If you are applying for a fee exemption, send your completed application with certified copies of your documents to the address on the form.
 Citizenship appointment
 Most people aged between 18 and 59 years will have an appointment to sit the citizenship test. We will send you an appointment letter with the details. The time from when you apply to your appointment date varies, but can take several months. Some applicants do not have to sit the citizenship test but may have an interview with us. Find out about the citizenship test and interview.
 Wait for our decision

 An Australian citizenship certificate is an important legal document that you must look after. It is an offence under section 39 of the Australian Citizenship Act 2007 to alter this document, or to allow it to be altered by another person. You must not write on or change any details on the certificate. Some Australian Government departments and agencies, as well as private organisations may refuse to accept laminated or damaged certificates.
 Getting an Australian passport
 You cannot apply for an Australian passport until you have received evidence of your citizenship from us. For information about applying for an Australian passport, including how long it takes, visit the Australian passport office website.
